returns._0: A strictly increasing identifier, bumped once per accepted attestation.
The unix timestamp of the latest attestation.
The total USDC reserves currently attested (6-decimal USDC units).

restateWithoutNewProof(uint256,uint256).notice: Overwrite the current attestation in place, WITHOUT bumping the id. Models an operator restating the same proof; ArcSettlement must not treat this as new evidence that a redemption outflow has been observed.

setReserves(uint256,uint256).notice: Publish a new attestation (bumps the attestation id, as a real one does).
